name.zh: 朗島的女性長輩：小米田除草
name.en: Iraraley woman elder: weed the millet field

review: 小米在朗島的種植時節與相關祭儀

steps.text: 朗島的女性長輩請你幫忙拔草
steps.textEn: The Iraraley woman elder asks you to help pull weeds

lines.zh: 小米長出來了，草也長得快。來幫我拔草，小心不要拔到小米。
lines.en: The millet is up, and the weeds grow fast too. Help me weed — careful not to pull the millet.

lines.zh: 田要常常照顧，不然草會比小米還高。
lines.en: A field needs regular care, or the weeds grow taller than the millet.

steps.text: 跟著女性長輩在田邊拔草
steps.textEn: Pull weeds by the field with the woman elder

lines.zh: 這株是草，這株是小米……長得好像！
lines.en: This one's a weed, this one's millet… they look so alike!

lines.zh: 葉子比較細的是小米，慢慢就認得了。
lines.en: The one with thinner leaves is millet. You'll get the hang of it.

steps.text: 向朗島的女性長輩回報
steps.textEn: Report to the Iraraley woman elder

lines.zh: 謝謝你。這一小把是去年留下的，拿去看看。小米怎麼收、什麼時候收，以後再教你。
lines.en: Thank you. This little handful is from last year — take a look. I'll teach you how and when to harvest millet another time.

hint.zh: 朗島的女性長輩在照顧小米田，正缺人手拔草。
hint.en: The Iraraley woman elder looks after the millet field and needs help weeding.

name.zh: 朗島的長輩：今年先修哪一條船
name.en: Iraraley elder: which boat to fix first this year

review: 女性與拼板舟的距離規矩

steps.text: 朗島的長輩要族男一起去看船
steps.textEn: The Iraraley elder wants the Tao man to come look at the boats

lines.zh: 冬天要決定先修哪一條船。跟我去灘頭看看，只看，不要碰別人家的船。
lines.en: In winter we decide which boat to fix first. Come to the beach with me. Just look — don't touch other families' boats.

steps.text: 族男跟長輩到朗島灘頭看拼板舟
steps.textEn: The Tao man goes to the Iraraley beach with the elder to look at the plank boats

lines.zh: 這條船的船板有一點裂開了。
lines.en: This boat's planks are cracking a little.
Sharp eyes. This one gets fixed first.

lines.zh: 船怎麼修、什麼時候修，是船組一起決定的。你今天看得很仔細。
lines.en: How and when to fix a boat is decided by the crew together. You looked very carefully today.

lines.zh: 女孩子和外面來的朋友，就從遠一點的地方看。
lines.en: Girls and friends from outside watch from a bit further away.

hint.zh: 冬天朗島的長輩會去灘頭看船，決定今年先修哪一條。
hint.en: In winter, the Iraraley elder goes to the beach to look at the boats and decide which one to fix first this year.
